description: This file defines the DefaultOAuthConfig class, implementing OAuthConfig, which loads OAuth-related configuration settings such as protocol and OpenID Connect issuers from a Typesafe Config. It includes methods for instantiation, accessors, and an internal collector class for processing configuration entries into a map.

classes.name: DefaultOAuthConfig
classes.description: Immutable implementation of OAuthConfig that loads OAuth settings from a config source, including protocol and issuer maps.

classes.name: DefaultOAuthConfig.SubjectIssuerCollector
classes.description: A collector class for transforming configuration entries into an unmodifiable map of SubjectIssuer to String.

methods.name: DefaultOAuthConfig.of
methods.description: Factory method to create an instance of DefaultOAuthConfig from a Config object.

methods.name: DefaultOAuthConfig.getOpenIdConnectIssuers
methods.description: Returns the map of SubjectIssuer to issuer URLs for OpenID Connect.

methods.name: DefaultOAuthConfig.getOpenIdConnectIssuersExtension
methods.description: Returns the extended map of SubjectIssuer to issuer URLs.
